items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: He plays with me right regularly. Anything I get, I call him, you know, he'd come right on up there.

ctx.x: He plays with me right regularly. Anything I get, I call him, you know, he'd come right on up there.

I was gonna ask about some of the other old time days and the jobs you played, like, they tell me they used to have, every time they'd have a wedding party or a christening or a birthday or anything else, they'd have a band in the old days. That's right. And they don't do that now. They got a jukebox or nothing at all, radio.
